argument_descriptions_json: [{"name":"src_col","type":"Utf8","required":false,"default":"src"},{"name":"dst_col","type":"Utf8","required":false,"default":"dst"},{"name":"weight_col","type":"Utf8|null","required":false,"semantic_effect":"edge weights affect algorithm results when provided","note":"optional edge weight column for graph construction when supported by the algorithm"}]
limitations_json: ["dry-run validates table resolution, column presence, static dtypes, and options only","dry-run does not scan edge data, construct a graph, or prove source-vertex existence","similarity is explicit-pair only; all-pairs candidate generation and all-pairs top-k search are not exposed","options_json must name vertex_pairs_table, first_vertex_col, and second_vertex_col","candidate-pair columns must match the graph vertex domain; logical string graphs accept Utf8, LargeUtf8, or Utf8View independently per column","null candidate-pair values are rejected at execution and are never dropped","candidate pairs are a multiset: duplicate, reversed, and self pairs remain distinct output rows","result rows have no global ordering; use ORDER BY when order is required","providing weight_col selects weighted similarity; omitting it selects unit-weight similarity","cuGraph requires directed=false so the graph is constructed as an undirected/symmetric view"]
options_schema_json: {"graph_options":{"directed":{"scope":"graph","type":"Boolean","default":false,"description":"Whether graph construction treats edges as directed.","allowed_values":[false],"valid_when":"required false: similarity operates on an undirected/symmetric graph"},"renumber":{"scope":"graph","type":"Boolean","default":true,"description":"Whether graph construction may renumber external vertex identifiers internally."},"construction_policy":{"scope":"graph","type":"Utf8","allowed_values":["python_cugraph","raw_libcugraph"],"default":"python_cugraph","description":"Edge-list construction semantics used before calling libcugraph."}},"algorithm_options":{"vertex_pairs_table":{"scope":"side_input","type":"Utf8","required":true,"description":"Table or view containing the explicit candidate vertex pairs.","side_input":{"role":"vertex_pairs","column_options":["first_vertex_col","second_vertex_col"]}},"first_vertex_col":{"scope":"side_input","type":"Utf8","required":true,"description":"First endpoint column in vertex_pairs_table.","column_of":"vertex_pairs_table","expected_type_ref":"vertex_pairs_domain"},"second_vertex_col":{"scope":"side_input","type":"Utf8","required":true,"description":"Second endpoint column in vertex_pairs_table.","column_of":"vertex_pairs_table","expected_type_ref":"vertex_pairs_domain"}},"type_aliases":{"vertex_domain":"same numeric or logical string domain as src_col and dst_col","vertex_pairs_domain":"same Int32/Int64 dtype for numeric graphs; any Utf8/LargeUtf8/Utf8View member for logical string graphs"}}
